_doc: Bannerline races: armour mix, the one visible economy trait, and the unit roster (6 per race in v1). Player-facing names only; never show Farhold warband `name` fields (one contains a banned word). `hpMult` is a per-race HP scale set by tools/econ-sim.mjs balancing (race-vs-race win rates 45-55%); it applies at runtime on top of units.json hp. `econModelHpMult` (optional) is the HP scale tools/econ-sim.mjs uses instead of hpMult for a race whose real-sim strength the model cannot see (the model has no positions, so pack bodies swarming a hero's engage limit are invisible to it). hpMult is tuned on the REAL sim with tools/matchups.mjs.

cheap_steel.name: Cheap Steel
cheap_steel.desc: Tier 1-4 units cost 15% less, add 10% less income, and hold one more in stock.

grave_tithe.name: Grave Tithe
grave_tithe.desc: A unit that reaches the enemy Keep refunds a quarter of its cost.
